description: This script manages the review lifecycle (start, stop, clear) for components based on metadata.yaml files in a repository. It calculates review deadlines, updates metadata, and regenerates reports while providing user help.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds and lists all components with metadata.yaml excluding docs and scripts directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves and returns the path to a component's metadata.yaml, or exits if not found.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date by adding business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Resets review lifecycle date fields in a metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Calls an external script to regenerate the RAG report.
